name: Infantry_Notify
author: Infantry AI
description: System notifications for milestones only (Windows toast, Android notification, browser notification) with custom sounds and a script bridge.

config.title: Notification sounds
config.applies: Applies to: the sounds a notification can play. Add your own .wav/.mp3/.ogg to <state dir>/plugin-data/Infantry_Notify/sounds/.

tools.name: infantry_notify
tools.description: Send one system notification (milestones and checkpoints only) to the owner's devices, with an optional sound.

tools.name: infantry_notify_milestone
tools.description: Mark a ticket as a milestone (notifyOnDone): one notification when it enters done.

config.title: Notifications
config.applies: Applies to: system notifications. Nothing notifies on its own: only a script, an agent, the CLI or a ticket marked as a milestone sends one.

fields.label: Notifications on
fields.description: Master switch. Off = every request is dropped.

fields.label: Quiet hours (HH:mm-HH:mm, empty = off)
fields.description: Inside these hours only an urgent notification plays a sound; the rest arrive silent.

fields.label: Default sound
fields.description: chime, bell, alarm, a file name in the sounds folder, or none.

fields.label: Milestone sound
fields.description: The sound of a milestone ticket's notification when the ticket names none.

fields.label: Keep undelivered notifications (minutes)
fields.description: A notification sent while no client is connected waits this long for one.

fields.label: Largest sound sent (bytes)
fields.description: A larger sound file is not sent; the notification arrives silent.
